summary: Component I0 of the plan docs/plans/wave-integration-2026-10.md (decision D2, ADR-0147). The spec is docs/architecture/wave-orchestrator.md section 15. A deliverable is a record that holds the cycle commits, the audit binding, the declared scope and the deps. It also holds the inbox rank, the risk class, the base_sha and the patch-id of each commit. The landed identity is the cycle trailer plus the patch-id. At enforce, the ship of a fleet lane stops before main and writes the record.
